mapper.select: SELECT * FROM support_goals WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{user.id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO support_goals (user_id, version, title, description, completion_criteria, status, actions_json, updated_at) VALUES (#{user.id}, #{version}, #{title}, #{description}, #{completionCriteria}, #{status}, #{actionsJson}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE support_goals SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, completion_criteria = #{completionCriteria}, status = #{status}, actions_json = #{actionsJson}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{user.id} AND version = #{version}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM support_goals WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{user.id} AND version = #{version}
